resources.string: Enter focus. Build knowledge. Up to 3 sessions a day.
One uninterrupted mission. Minimum 30 minutes. Completed sessions earn 30 XP up to 60 minutes, or 100 XP above 60 minutes. Every start uses an attempt.
At least 30 minutes and the full linked task target. The session must fit before the daily reset.
That task is no longer available. Choose another task or an independent mission.
Finish, pause or discard your other timer before entering Study Mode. Hyperfocus must be ended first.
Three attempts used. Your next study allowance opens at the daily reset.
You can leave this screen; time keeps running in the same boot. Reboot, restore or daily reset ends an unfinished attempt without XP. No Pause or Resume.
This attempt will stay in history, use one of today’s three starts and earn no XP or linked task progress.
Mission target reached · +%1$d Study XP ready
What did you learn or complete?
Your first mission awaits. Completed, incomplete and discarded attempts will appear here.
Unable to apply this action. Check your daily attempts, other timers, linked task, required duration and time before the daily reset.
This task session is controlled in Study Mode. Return there to finish or discard it.
Complete or discard the active Study mission before starting or resuming another timer.

string-array.name: study_quotes
string-array.item: One clear objective. One deliberate step. Begin.
Understanding grows where your attention stays.
Build the knowledge your next challenge will need.
A difficult page is an invitation to think more carefully.
Give this moment a purpose, then give it your attention.
Every question you untangle leaves a stronger foundation.
Progress can be quiet. Keep working with intention.
Master this step. The next one will become clearer.
You do not need every answer to make a meaningful start.
Turn curiosity into a question, and the question into action.
Let careful work become something you can build upon.
